newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Ramadan to begin in Kuwait on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Ramadan to begin in Kuwait on Friday.

text.p: A Kuwaiti panel of judges has said Friday would be the first day of the Moslem fasting month of Ramadan in the Gulf Arab state, an official said on Thursday.
Adults who violate a ban on eating, drinking and smoking in public during daylight hours could be sent to jail for the rest of the holy month, residents say.
Many Kuwaitis go to Saudi Arabia for pilgrimage during Ramadan. Government offices and private businesses are required to shorten their work hours.
